input.summary: Shell and floors built in parts/shell.mjs and make.sh gives a whole build.nbt: paved streets and alleys, calcite and frame end-bay walls with plinth, cart arches, passage ceiling, floor slabs y12 and y18, gallery partitions z14 and z23, hatches with ladders, stairs 1 and 2. make.sh showed no REFUSED or off-palette lines. The Lobby, Stair hall and Counting room walk as ok; the last full walk output I read was cut off after Pocket A1, so I haven't confirmed the rest. I didn't render the tiles.
left: I did not render the tiles, so I haven't looked at how the part reads.
The last mcd walk output I read stopped at Pocket A1. The remaining rooms (pockets, cart passage, stores, gallery, loft) are unconfirmed.

I did not re-run mcd walk or the other checks after the final change. I did not confirm the six ladders at y11 are now supported. That change was six dark_oak_planks cells at (11,11,15), (19,11,15), (27,11,15) and (15,11,22), (23,11,22), (31,11,22).
The first check showed 1848 floating blocks in the roof. The Timber frame part is still a stub, so no upper walls exist yet.
Doorways at x3..4 and x20..21 (y13..15) are cut in both gallery partitions. This is my addition, so stair 1 and stair 2 connect.
The west bay is one open hall with no partitions: the lobby, stair hall and counting room boxes meet with no wall between them.
Windows at x3 and x7 (y6..8) and the door and transom cells (x5..6, y5..7) in the west-bay street walls are left as air for the fittings part.
Room floors (lobby polished_andesite, plank floors) are not laid; the podium cobblestone is still the floor. The room designers need to replace it.

waste.what: Worked out by hand which cells of the y12 and y18 slabs, the partitions and the walls to leave open for stairs, hatches, doorways and arches
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate sets computed from plan.md; one make.sh iteration to find unsupported ladders
waste.tool: a floorSlab(g, box, y, holes[]) helper and a partition(g, z, x0, x1, doorways[]) helper

waste.what: Wrote wall-with-holes helpers (wallZ and wallX) because frameBay is for upper storeys only
waste.tool: a vocab wallPanel(g, plane, posts, holes) helper

companions.task: Walk both flights, check headroom, and place the rails and the partition doorways at the stair tops.
Add quoins and cobbled jambs to the end-bay corners and arch jambs, and lintels over the openings.
